note: Topic-free items. split: train | eval | both. Acknowledgements are Moshi's own lines (shared); greetings are in data/splits/phrasings.json. Friend names, distractors, self-talk and wait-like phrases are held out by ID (every third for eval); phone calls, door visits and reading murmurs are eval-only.

wait_like.text: Hold on, can you say that again?
Wait, what was the last part?
Wait, are you sure about that?
Wait a second, that doesn't sound right.

check: I'm fairly sure about it, but I could be wrong. What sounds off to you?
Let me double-check. I'd still stand by it, but tell me what you heard.
Good to question it. I still think it's right, though you know your situation best.
Hmm, I believe it is. Which part doesn't sound right?

turns.text: The independent candidate, I'll leave you a leaflet.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I'll read it later.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey, buddy.

turns.speaker: visitor
turns.text: Can my ball have come over your fence?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Probably, was it red?

turns.speaker: visitor
turns.text: Yeah! Can I get it?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Wait here, I'll throw it back over.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hiya, one sec, let me get the chain off.

turns.speaker: visitor
turns.text: Hi, I'm the new tenant across the hall, I just wanted to introduce myself.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, welcome! When did you move in?

turns.speaker: visitor
turns.text: Yesterday, it's still chaos.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Shout if you need anything, I've got a drill.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hi, are you the electrician?

turns.speaker: visitor
turns.text: That's right, here to look at the fuse box.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It's in the hallway cupboard. Do you need the lights on?

turns.speaker: visitor
turns.text: A torch is fine, I've got one.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I'll be in the kitchen.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Who is it?

turns.speaker: visitor
turns.text: Pardon me, do you know where the community hall is? My map's useless.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It's two streets down, past the church. Are you walking?

turns.speaker: visitor
turns.text: Yes, I'm late for choir.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Then turn left at the bakery, it's quicker.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, wow, flowers?

turns.speaker: visitor
turns.text: Happy anniversary, I didn't forget this year.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: You're early! Did you leave work?

turns.speaker: visitor
turns.text: I snuck out at lunch.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Get in here, you.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hi.

turns.speaker: visitor
turns.text: Hello, I'm reading the gas meter. Is it inside or out?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Under the stairs. Will you need long?

turns.speaker: visitor
turns.text: Thirty seconds.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey, come on in.

turns.speaker: visitor
turns.text: I can't stay, I just brought back your casserole dish.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Did you like the lasagne?

turns.speaker: visitor
turns.text: The kids fought over the last piece.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Ha, I'll give you the recipe.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes?

turns.speaker: visitor
turns.text: Hi, I'm selling chocolate for the scouts. They're two pounds each.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: What flavours have you got?

turns.speaker: visitor
turns.text: Mint, orange and plain.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'll take a mint and an orange.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, a parcel for me?

turns.speaker: visitor
turns.text: Hi, courier. This one needs ID, it's age restricted.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Will a driving licence do?

turns.speaker: visitor
turns.text: Perfect, thanks.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Great, cheers.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, hey, Uncle Tom.

turns.speaker: visitor
turns.text: Your dad said you needed a hand with the shelves.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: He sent you? Did you bring a spirit level?

turns.speaker: visitor
turns.text: Brought the whole toolbox.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: You're a lifesaver.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hi, sorry, we're closed today.

turns.speaker: visitor
turns.text: Oh, isn't this the dentist?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: No, that's next door, the white house. Easy mistake?

turns.speaker: visitor
turns.text: Very easy, the numbers are confusing. Thanks.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, hi, what's this about?

turns.speaker: visitor
turns.text: Hi, we're doing a survey on recycling habits, it's very short.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: How short is very short?

turns.speaker: visitor
turns.text: Five questions, promise.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Alright, go on then.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, hello, can I help you?

turns.speaker: visitor
turns.text: Hi, I lived in this house as a kid. Sorry, I just wanted to see it again.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: No way! When was that?

turns.speaker: visitor
turns.text: Forty years ago, the tree out front was a sapling.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's lovely. Do you want to see the garden?

turns.speaker: visitor
turns.text: Would you mind? Thank you.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey, what's up?

turns.speaker: visitor
turns.text: Your car alarm's been going for ten minutes.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Seriously? I didn't hear a thing. Is it the silver one?

turns.speaker: visitor
turns.text: Yep, flashing like a disco.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thanks, I'll grab my keys.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hi, yes?

turns.speaker: visitor
turns.text: I'm here to collect the old sofa for the charity.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Already? Can you give me two minutes to clear the cushions?

turns.speaker: visitor
turns.text: Take your time, we're early.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Evening.

turns.speaker: visitor
turns.text: Hi! Is Mia home? We're going to the park.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: She's just finishing her homework. Can you wait five minutes?

turns.speaker: visitor
turns.text: Okay, we'll sit on the wall.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hi, can I help you?

turns.speaker: visitor
turns.text: I'm so sorry, I think I reversed into your bin.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh. Is your car okay?

turns.speaker: visitor
turns.text: My car's fine, your bin less so. I'll pay for a new one.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Honestly, it's ancient, don't worry about it.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey, look who it is!

turns.speaker: visitor
turns.text: Surprise, I'm back in town for a week.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Why didn't anyone tell me? Come here.

turns.speaker: visitor
turns.text: I wanted to see your face.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, finally, I'm starving.

turns.speaker: visitor
turns.text: Hi, food delivery, number ninety. Pad thai and spring rolls?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's right. Is there any chilli sauce in there?

turns.speaker: visitor
turns.text: Two packets, at the bottom.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, hello?

turns.speaker: visitor
turns.text: Hi, I'm from the building management. The lift will be off tomorrow morning.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Ugh, all morning? Until when?

turns.speaker: visitor
turns.text: Until about noon, sorry.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, thanks for warning me.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, hi, are you lost?

turns.speaker: visitor
turns.text: I'm looking for my grandma's house, it has a yellow door.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Do you know her name?

turns.speaker: visitor
turns.text: Grandma Rose.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: She's at the end, I'll walk you.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hi, oh, how festive!

turns.speaker: visitor
turns.text: Good evening, we're carol singers from the church, may we sing one?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, how lovely. Do you take requests?

turns.speaker: visitor
turns.text: We know about six songs.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Then surprise me.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hi, come in, it's freezing.

turns.speaker: visitor
turns.text: Hi, I'm the dog walker, I'm here for Rusty.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: You're new, aren't you? Where's Kim today?

turns.speaker: visitor
turns.text: She's off sick, I'm covering this week.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, his lead's on the hook. He pulls a bit.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey.

turns.speaker: visitor
turns.text: Hi, sorry, your music is really loud, my baby's trying to sleep.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, I'm so sorry. Is it better if I close the window?

turns.speaker: visitor
turns.text: That and maybe a bit quieter?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Of course, right away.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes? Oh, hello.

turns.speaker: visitor
turns.text: Census officer, you haven't returned your form yet.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, didn't I? Can I fill it in online?

turns.speaker: visitor
turns.text: Yes, the code's on this letter.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thanks, I'll do it tonight.

reading_murmurs.text: Hmm, the meeting moved to Thursday.
Hmm, by the end of the month.

wait_like_note: repeat: Moshi says the lead-in and then repeats its previous turn. check: Moshi answers with the line alone.
resume_openers_note: Moshi's resume = an opener for the wait type + the context's welcome_back line without its greeting sentence (e.g. 'Welcome back.'), so there is no 'welcome back' when the user never left.
